cacheQueries.scope: Synthetic SQLite adapter query counts, not physical latency.

pictureQueue.scope: Actual cache/renderer methods with synthetic HTTP/RDB; in-flight four may finish, remaining work is canceled; resume is cache-first.

deterministicEvidence.refresh: Held index and Sent do not hold visible Inbox completion. Repeated pulls preserve only latest companion intent. Background/composer/navigation guards prevent new requests; paused cached index resumes once.

nativeStorage.scope: Actual encrypted RDB:65 reversed headers across two batches, dirty inclusion/exclusion, pagination/query state, original offline body timestamp, close/reopen ordering and stale handle rejection. Zero mail calls.

nativeInboxLatency.scope: Synthetic Inbox plus one held Sent page; Inbox layout settles, repeated native pulls coalesce Sent, and cached reader opens before Sent release. Background bus signal prevents new requests.
nativeInboxLatency.limitations: This is a functional native gate, not a provider-latency, physical screen-lock, frame-rate, temperature or power measurement.

nativePictures.scope: Actual HtmlMail fitContent reader within Scroll; fresh HTTP200 PNG and200 replacement served as application/octet-stream pass NetworkKit ArrayBuffer handling, normalize to persisted image/png, and render natively; pending retry coalesces; two HTTP503 failures retain replacement bytes, timestamp, consent and visible colors. Four loopback requests only.
nativePictures.limits: Synthetic main-HAP fixture and loopback only; no production accounts or external servers.

emulator.earlyHarnessAttempt: A 300-second invocation was rejected by the wrapper limit before tests and stopped; the corrected 240-second group passed all three gates.

limits: Device temperature, battery life and real-provider refresh duration were not measured.
Queued picture cancellation has synthetic host coverage; native picture gate verifies actual renderer/cache/retry behavior.
Native Inbox background coverage injects the production foreground signal, not physical screen locking.
Already active picture downloads may finish and cache. Dispatched mail requests and bounded watch cleanup may briefly outlive the UI.
Server authentication, preview sampling and logout still contribute latency. Existing IMAP classification and MIME/CID limits remain.
Tablet split-layout source is unchanged; this round native Inbox gate uses the phone profile. Tablet evidence remains in 0.1.15.
